{{Quote|Ask Again Later|Eye of Mesra|<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
The '''Eye of Mesra''' was a small, round fortune-telling toy. An old [[Desert/Legends|desert]] tradition, they were commonly used by children of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Everything Will Proceed As You Have Foreseen|Eye of Mesra|<ref name="SWG" />}}
A [[Fortune teller/Legends|fortune-telling]] toy known as the [[Eye/Legends|Eye]] of Mesra was small and round in appearance, and resembled an eye. The exterior was [[Color/Legends|colored]] a light shade of pink, while the interior section was colored blue with a black colored pupil decal.<ref name="Visual" /> When the user asked the Eye of Mesra a question, it would respond with one of many types of answers, including a positive, negative, or noncommittal response.<ref name="SWG" /> In this way, the Eye of Mesra was similar to the [[Quay novelty toy]], another type of fortune-telling device.<ref name="Quay">{{StoryCite|story=The Great God Quay: The Tale of Barada and the Weequays|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|I've spent years perfecting my crafting skills, and now I'm ready to announce my mastery to the galaxy. I've chosen an unusual subject for my masterwork: an obscure religious icon of the Weequay species called the Eye of Mesra. For my design I require a rare material, and I hope you can locate it for me.|An unidentified citizen, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
The Eye of Mesra had its roots as an old [[Desert/Legends|desert]] tradition. Although they were commonly used by children in the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]],<ref name="Visual" /> they could also be found on many other [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], such as [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG" /> However, it did share a namesake with Tatooine's [[Great Mesra Plateau/Legends|Great Mesra Plateau]].<ref name="Worlds">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|In Dark Times, Nothing Is What It Appears To Be|Eye of Mesra|<ref name="SWG" />}}
The [[W:c:swg:Eyes of Mesra|Eye of Mesra]] received entries in a number of source books, including the ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide]]'' ([[1999]]),<ref name="Insider">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']] (1999),<ref name="Visual" /> and ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' ([[2008]]).<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|247|Eyes of Mesra}}</ref>

Their first appearance was as an [[W:c:swg:Item|item]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The item acted as a sort of mini-game, allowing players to ask the the Eye a question in return for a random answer,<ref name="SWG" /> much in the same way as a real world [[Wikipedia:Magic 8-Ball|Magic 8-Ball]].<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://toytales.ca/magic-8-ball-alabe-crafts|text=Magic 8-Ball from Alabe Crafts (1946)|author=Coopee, Todd|work=Toy Tales|archivedate=20200803133420}}</ref> In fact, the game's directory tree files refer to the Eyes of Mesra text Strings Table File as "magic_eight_ball."<ref name="TRE">{{GalaxiesAED}} directory tree files and source data</ref>

Following the release of [[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15 2005|Publish 25's]] [[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]] on [[November 15]], [[2005]], the Eye of Mesra was modified to actually allow the player to type a question into a prompt window displayed by the item.<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="NGE">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> The Eye of Mesra was later featured in a [[December 1]], [[2015]] [[StarWars.com]] news post, titled ''Let's Go Play Ball: Toys and Games from a Galaxy Far, Far Away'' by [[Tim Veekhoven]].<ref name="News">{{SW|url=news/lets-go-play-ball-toys-and-games-from-a-galaxy-far-far-away|text=Let's Go Play Ball: Toys and Games from a Galaxy Far, Far Away|nolive=1}}</ref>
